summary: Easterly Government Properties filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $200 million senior unsecured term loan agreement (with $50 million accordion) and an eleventh amendment to an existing 2016 term loan. These are routine financing transactions, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special event is disclosed. The filing describes customary credit terms, interest rate options, and financial covenants. As a pure capital markets transaction without any change-of-control or extraordinary corporate action, it does not fall under any listed special-situations category.
